title: Datacube Extension
description: Dimensions and variables for gridded, multidimensional, or tabular data.

dimensions.description: Cube axes: domain axes (e.g. crop, scenario), a vertical axis (type: z), place-key columns (type: location), and temporal axes (each type: temporal with a step). The horizontal lat/lon grid is derived from the top-level spatial field and is not declared here, and bands are variables rather than an axis.

name.description: Axis name. Must not be "variable": measures are not axes and belong in variables[]; href_template refers to them via the reserved {variable} token.

description.description: What the dimension is; define coded values here, or via reference_system or a sidecar.

type.description: Dimension type. Reserved values change how the dimension is read: `temporal` (an axis of ISO 8601 dates or instants - the only type that may carry a step, and a record may declare several, e.g. a year axis files are split on plus a day column inside them) and `z` (a vertical axis - depth, height, or pressure level - at most one per record, serialized as a spatial dimension on the z axis). `location` names a column identifying a place, such as an admin or station code. Any other value names a domain axis after what it varies (crop, scenario, season). `spatial` and `geometry` are rejected: the horizontal grid is derived from the top-level spatial field and never declared here, and STAC forbids both words as custom dimension types. Lowercase; aliases of `temporal` are rejected so a time axis cannot silently become a domain axis.

reference_system.description: Vocabulary the dimension's values are coded against; prefer a resolvable URI when one exists (e.g. an AGROVOC concept scheme).

step.description: Spacing of one step, as an ISO 8601 duration. Only valid on a type: temporal dimension.

unit.description: Unit of measurement for the values, preferably compliant with UDUNITS-2 or UCUM. Needed on a `z` dimension (m, cm, hPa) and useful on any numeric domain axis; not a substitute for reference_system, which names the vocabulary or vertical CRS the values are coded against.

values.description: On a temporal dimension, every value is an ISO 8601 date or instant, as a string. A binned axis lists each bin's start and states its length in step, so a 30-year period axis is values: ["2021", "2051"] with step: P30Y. A cyclic label axis (DJF/MAM/JJA/SON) is not temporal - name it after what it varies and describe the labels.

description.description: Stable definition and reading guidance for the variable.

dimensions.description: Axes this variable spans; omit when it spans all declared dimensions.

unit.description: Unit of measurement, preferably compliant with UDUNITS-2 or UCUM.

nodata.description: No-data / fill value for this variable, where it differs from the asset's. Takes precedence over the asset's nodata for this variable only.

joins.description: Joins from this table to other catalogued datasets. Each entry pairs this record's key columns with the target's columns, positionally.

target.description: Resolvable URI or id of the dataset joined to (e.g. a boundary/station record).

left_fields.description: Key columns in this record; each must be a declared dimensions[]/variables[] name.

right_fields.description: Matching columns in the target, paired positionally with left_fields (same length).
